messages:
zoe_fin: FYI INV-9450 (QubitOps) failed: virtual card declined with 'issuer policy: no cross-border billing' — customer onboarding this afternoon.

leon_sales: On call with them. They say their procurement only issues virtual cards for international vendors and issuer blocks USD charges where merchant country != issuer country.

payments-bot: webhook: gateway=Stripe, decline_code=issuer_policy_crossborder, attempt_id=at_237890, time=2026-03-27T15:06Z. Automatic retry scheduled in 12h (rty_237890).

ivy_support: Customer asked for options: they can 1) provide a corporate ACH, 2) do an immediate wire, or 3) we can accept a different physical card. They don't want to wait for their bank to reissue.

marc_ops: Quick ops notes: pause retries if taking manual route. We also need clear reconciliation steps so bookings team can map bank txns to invoice.

zoe_fin: Pausing auto-retry now. Leon, ask AE if they'll accept a one-time processing fee waiver and confirm wire/ACH preference. Also ask customer to upload their PO + remittance email to support portal for matching.

leon_sales: AE agreed to waive manual fee for this customer (pricing-experiment waiver). Told customer: "We can accept Plaid Instant ACH (if US), or wire now. We'll waive the $25 manual-processing fee for this invoice as a one-time exception."

ivy_support: Customer picked wire. Drafting wire instructions and KYC checklist.

ivy_support: Wire (USD) instructions to customer:

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Coast Bank
Account: 445566778
Routing (ABA): 021000021
SWIFT: FCBUS33
Reference: INV-9450 / QubitOps
```

ivy_support: Also asked them to include sender bank reference and upload the transaction copy once sent so we can reconcile quickly.

marc_ops: Action items for finance: 1) when wire posts, run `payments:mark-paid INV-9450 txn=<bank_txn_id>` to avoid duplicate auto-capture, 2) record manual-waiver tag `pricing-experiment-waive-25` for audit, 3) create a ticket for revenue ops to map wire to invoice.

zoe_fin: I'll mark the invoice `onboarding-hold` and add the waiver tag after payment posts. Please include the uploaded remittance in the invoice notes.

eng-telemetry: We should add a short telemetry event for `decline_reason=issuer_policy_crossborder` with fields: `card_country`, `billing_country`, `gateway_code`. I'll raise a small RFC to capture these for 90 days to quantify the problem.

marc_ops: Also consider making the invoice UI detect cross-border virtual cards and show a friendly path: "If your virtual card issuer blocks cross-border charges, try Plaid/ACH or wire." Small UX experiment.

leon_sales: AE to confirm once wire sent. Customer replied "wire sent, will forward receipt."

payments-bot: Reminder: when posting wire, use `payments:mark-paid INV-9450 txn=<bank_txn_id>` and include `manual_waiver=pricing-experiment-waive-25` in metadata to ensure accounting picks it up.
